findings.description: The cycle guard was removed from the __cause__ chain walk, so the while loop no longer terminates if the chain is cyclic.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a retried function raises an exception whose __cause__ chain loops back on itself, for example a.__cause__ = b and b.__cause__ = a, or e.__cause__ = e, and no link matches exception_cause_types. Mechanism: the loop only stops on a None cause, and the removed seen-set check was the only thing that stopped it on a repeated object, so it spins forever. Impact: the retry decision never returns and the calling thread hangs.
